Build-Depends: debhelper-compat (= 14), dh-sequence-python3, pybuild-plugin-pyproject, python3 (>= 3.10), python3-httpx2 (>= 2.0), python3-packaging, python3-pdm-backend, python3-pytest <!nocheck>, python3-pytest-mock <!nocheck>, python3-trustme <!nocheck>, python3-flask <!nocheck>
Description: utility to fetch and download Python packages This package provides a utility to fetch and download Python packages. It exists as the last piece to complete the puzzle of a package manager, and provide low-level functionalities that are needed to resolve and install packages. . Unearth serves as a stable replacement for pip's PackageFinder API. It will follow the conventions of Semantic Versioning so that downstream projects can use it to develop their own package finding and downloading.
